description: Plan détaillé (texte) des ports du département de la Manche (50) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Text and toponymy relating to the detailed plans of the ports of the department of the Channel. (layer “PORTS50text”). Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Detailed map (text) of the ports of the department of the Channel (50)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include toponymie, texte, DDTM50, Geographical names, zones portuaires. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
